title: Sorting array with reverse around middle

example.expected: Yes We can choose sub-array[3, 4, 5] on reversing this we get [1, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 7] again on selecting [6, 5, 4, 3, 2] and reversing this one we get [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7] which is sorted at last thus it is possible to sort on multiple reverse operation.
